planets.name: KELT-20 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-20 with a 3.47-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: KELT-20 b was found in 2017 by KELT-North as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-20. Its orbit and size follow Lund et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
